body:

Supersedes, for its own areas only, the wave-1 Tier 1 record #25815 (shared with card W2-C2a, which owns the other Tier 1 areas). Maintainer ordered the wave directly; this is a test run and lane/seat dispatch does not apply.

## Environment fingerprint

- Cold container: `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` 25 s (01:30:01–01:30:26Z); `pnpm build --concurrency=2` 119/119 tasks, exit 0, 01:30:26–01:42:39Z; `pnpm console:build --concurrency=2` exit 0 at 01:42:39Z (cache hit + copy). Console build line: `packages/console/dist` built 01:42Z from 756220c4, served at `/_console/` (200). `node scripts/check-dev-prereqs.mjs` green (108 package build artifacts present).
- Chromium: playwright-core wants build 1243; `/opt/pw-browsers` holds `chromium-1243` / `chromium_headless_shell-1243` — they agree, stock configs launch as-is.
- vitest: one package per invocation, `--maxWorkers=1`, JSON reporter; ui suites from `ui/` root (the objectui vitest guard refuses package-dir launches); the one cli `*.e2e.test.*` pin in its own invocation with `OS_TEST_TIERS=nightly`, every other cli pin without it.
- Boots (each its own non-default port and its own file DB under the run scratch dir, `--seed-admin`, `OS_PORT` exported beside `-p`, started with `setsid`, stopped by process group, port confirmed free): pins stack showcase `:41720` + console Vite dev server `:5191` (`DEV_PROXY_TARGET`) for `ui/e2e/live`, the same `:41720` serving `/_console` for `examples/app-showcase` Playwright; live-leg runners L1 `:41711`, L2 `:41712`, L3 `:41713`, L4 `:41714`, L5 `:41715`; fail verification `:41730`. Seed: stock showcase + seeded admin; personas minted per RUNNER (invite-then-sign-up / admin create-user). Every fixture a runner staged is named in its clause evidence.
- Parallelism: 5 read-only clause-mapping subagents (by area group) re-derived every clause from the item text and pin source at this tree (#25815 read only for comparison); 5 live-leg runner subagents, each with its own port/DB/browser context, at most 3 browsers at once; the parent ran every pin, sequentially, after the build had finished.
- Timestamps (UTC, 2026-10-27): env prep 01:30–01:43; clause mapping 01:31–01:47; framework vitest pins 01:43–01:58; ui unit pins 01:58–02:00; extra pins 02:00–02:02; `ui/e2e/live` 02:03–02:09; showcase Playwright 02:09–02:11; live legs 01:44–02:38 (incl. probes); fail verification 02:40–02:44.

## Scope

Each row of the item table carries the revision its verdict is valid for (all equal the resolver's `revision`). Blocked items are excluded by the resolver (`records-forms.record-edit-undo`, carried forward below). No `planned` item carries a ref; `records-forms.picklist-shared-across-objects` is planned and out of this selector.

The 15 wave-1 NOT-RUN items in these areas got a **live leg** this time (L1–L5): `i18n.surface-matrix`, `integration-system.connector-descriptor-audit`, `platform-core.url-overlay-contract`, `records-forms.bulk-select-all-matching`, `records-forms.concurrent-edit-conflict`, `records-forms.conditional-rules-grid`, `records-forms.delete-behavior-matrix`, `records-forms.field-type-constraints`, `records-forms.gantt-interactions`, `records-forms.import-job-undo-cancel`, `records-forms.list-view-capabilities`, `records-forms.record-clone-contract`, `records-forms.record-discussion-mentions`, `studio-authoring.org-override-registry-gate`, `studio-authoring.permission-matrix-editor-ux`.

## How a clause scores (RUNNER rule 6)

A pin scores a clause `pass` only when a named case asserts it at the oracle's layer (`unit` · `in-process` · `http-in-process` · `live-boot` · `browser` · `component`). A pin that asserts the expectation but stops above the oracle's layer scores the clause **`partial`, naming the missing layer** (the card's instruction and RUNNER's literal wording; #25815 recorded these as not-run, so its counts are not directly comparable). A clause no pin asserts is `not-run`. A live-leg verdict overrides the pin verdict for its clause; a live `blocked` sub-leg under a passed clause makes it `partial`. Clause evidence (pin file + layer, or the live oracle line) is in the detail comments below, one line per clause.

## Fail — reproduction rule

**`i18n.surface-matrix` n1** (rev 10, P1) — "a surface whose group the spec declares … showing NO translation while the bundle carries one for it is a FAIL against the resolver". Found by L4, re-derived independently by the parent on a fresh boot (:41730), reproduced twice per browser locale.

1. Boot the stock showcase; sign in as `admin@objectos.ai` through the console form, in a browser context whose locale is **en-US**.
2. Set the user's language to zh-CN: avatar menu → Language → 中文（中国）, or `PATCH /api/v1/data/sys_user/USER_ID` `{"locale":"zh-CN"}` → 200.
3. Confirm the bundle: `GET /api/v1/i18n/translations/zh-CN` carries `objects.showcase_task.fields.status.options` = `{backlog: 待规划, todo: 待办, in_progress: 进行中, in_review: 评审中, done: 已完成}` and priority options.
4. Open `/_console/forms/showcase_task.form?recordId=ANY_TASK_ID&recordObject=showcase_task`; wait for the form to render.
5. Read `select` option texts and the `[role=combobox]` values.

Expected: options 待规划/待办/进行中/评审中/已完成 and 低/中/高/紧急 (as field labels and sections are, on the same page). Actual: labels `标题*`, `状态*`, `优先级` are zh, but the selects read `Backlog|To Do|In Progress|In Review|Done` and `Low|Medium|High|Urgent`, combobox `In Review` / `High`. Control 1: the in-app overlay form `/_console/apps/com.example.showcase/showcase_task?form=ID` in the same session renders `进行中|评审中|已完成` / `低|中|高|紧急`. Control 2: the same `/forms` URL in a **zh-CN** browser context renders zh options — the options are only translated when the server localizes the schema by `Accept-Language`, never from the user's chosen language. Source: `ui/apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx` ~L848 `options: normalizeOptions(def.options)` (no option-label translation; labels/placeholder go through the localizer). Traps ruled out: stale-console-bundle (dist built 01:42Z from this tree; source agrees), hydration-race (screenshot first, waited for the section heading), automation-input (read-only DOM reads). Not auth.

## Off-clause probes (rule 8)

~25 min in total, 5 min per live runner, on the same boots and personas (admin, `auditor.demo`, `phone.demo`, admin-minted members, a contributor-bound member, anonymous). Doors and boundary classes: `/data` field-zoo boundaries (0/1000, empty string, `[]`, `''` lookup/select, `1e400`), clone (string `overrides`, empty body, client `id`, empty id path), DELETE unknown/already-deleted id; OCC `If-Match` absent/garbage/`*`/weak `W/`; discussion empty body, unknown thread/mention id, member create/read; import double undo, unknown job, cancel on terminal job, member routes; `/meta/permission` as non-admins, unknown/bare/empty field keys, packaged set; `/apps/showcase/recalc` empty/unknown ids; export as unentitled personas; i18n routes anonymous and with `zh`/`zh-cn`/blank locale; console cold-loads of `?palette`, `?shortcuts`, unknown `?recordId`/`?form`, bogus `?tab`.

Passed the filing gate and extracted at close-out: (1) an **authorization-class** observation on record-discussion mention notifications, single-organization boot — detail withheld pending maintainer (RUNNER rule 2 carve-out); (2) the `/forms` route also hard-codes its refusal and missing-recordId messages in English (folded into the n1 card). Observed, not filed (not reproduced twice, or minor/by design): `If-Match: *` answers 409 rather than matching any current version; an unknown mention id is accepted silently; for ~30 s after an import cancel the job reports 0 written and undo answers 422 `NOT_UNDOABLE`, then self-corrects (seen on two jobs); a stock `org_member` can neither read nor create `sys_comment` (likely posture); the select-all banner keeps saying "All 5010 matching records are selected" while the fan-out stops at 5000; `?form=UNKNOWN_ID` opens a blank edit form; the invoice detail drawer lists line position 1 above 0; recalc with empty `_selectedIds` fails inside the flow instead of a clean 400; auto-schedule says "All dependencies satisfied" while a locked task still violates its link; a task PATCH with end before start is accepted (no rule declared).
